mapper.select: SELECT admin_user_id AS adminUserId, username, password_hash AS passwordHash, display_name AS displayName, role, enabled, failed_login_count AS failedLoginCount, locked_until AS lockedUntil, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, last_failed_at AS lastFailedAt FROM admin_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}
UPDATE admin_user SET failed_login_count = failed_login_count + 1, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, last_failed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}
